current_task_corrections.correction: Change denial_rate denominator parameter from 'all_claims' to 'adjudicated_claims'. Adjudicated claims are those with status in {Paid, Denied, Adjusted}, excluding Pended claims which have not been decided.
Change monthly_trend date_column parameter from 'adjudication_date' to 'service_date_from' to reflect the timing of care delivery rather than claim adjudication.

reusable_lessons.lesson: When computing denial rates, use adjudicated claims (Paid, Denied, Adjusted) as the denominator, excluding Pended claims which have not yet been decided. State the denominator choice explicitly in all rate calculations.

When trending claim volumes over time, key the monthly series on service_date_from (when care was delivered), not adjudication_date (when claims were decided). Service dates better represent care delivery timing and are more consistent.
